title: Bitstamp Earn - Stake Ethereum and let your crypto work for you
notes: First-party announcement stating that Ethereum staking at Bitstamp was live on 13 July 2021 under the Earn section, with Bitstamp handling the technical staking process and jurisdiction restrictions noted.

title: ETH staking coming to Bitstamp - sign up for early access
notes: First-party article documenting that Bitstamp had started a gradual Ethereum-staking rollout in April 2021 with early access, distinguishing the rollout phase from the later full public launch.

title: What is staking?
notes: Current first-party educational material documenting Bitstamp Earn staking, protocol-level staking rewards and risks, jurisdiction exclusions, a 15% commission on protocol rewards, and Bitstamp's statement that customers maintain full ownership of crypto assets when staking.

title: Winding down ALGO staking on Bitstamp
notes: First-party notice ending ALGO staking on 1 April 2025 because of an Algorand protocol transition while directing users to other staking and lending options in Bitstamp Earn, supporting product-specific rather than platform-wide shutdown treatment.

title: To stake or not to stake? For our UK customers, that's no longer the question.
notes: First-party UK relaunch material documenting active Bitstamp Earn staking for ETH and ADA in the UK in May 2025 and illustrating jurisdiction-specific availability rather than one universal market footprint.
